# Sharing a list

Share a list with the people you shop with, and you'll all see the same
items: what's been added, what's been bought, what's still to get.

## Sharing a list with someone

1. Open the list you want to share. You need to be its owner.
2. Under **Share**, type the other person's email address in **Share with
   (email)** — the address they use to sign in to Pantry.
3. Press **Share**.

Pantry says "Shared with" and their email at the top of the list, and their
name appears under **Share**. The next time they open **Your lists**, the list
is waiting for them under **Shared with me**.

The person you share with needs a Pantry account already. If they don't have
one yet, ask whoever runs Pantry for your household to create it.

## What the other person can do

They can add items, mark items bought or not bought, and delete items. They
can't rename the list, delete it, or share it with anyone else. See
[Lists shared with you](lists.md#lists-shared-with-you).

## Seeing who a list is shared with

Open the list. Under **Share**, Pantry lists everyone it's shared with, by
name and email. "Not shared with anyone" means it's only yours.

## If Pantry can't find the person

If Pantry says **No user with that email**, it couldn't find an account with
the address you typed. Check the address for typos and try again, or ask the
other person which address they sign in with.

If you see **You already own this list**, you've typed your own email.

## Sharing with someone twice

Sharing a list with someone who already has it does no harm: Pantry tells you
it's shared, and nothing changes.
